title: E2R | Easy To Run
description: Simple modpack for optimized and smooth Minecraft Experience
body:
**A very simple modpack for people that just want vanilla minecraft with more performance. 
Default game, no complex mods.**

To be more precise, this modpack improves performance without changing the game's way to work. It is a compilation of optimization mods, a zoom, [Optifine](https://optifine.net/home) capes, and some little enhancements to quality of life especially with Entity Features mods, dynamic lights and borderless fullscreen capability.

This modpack is a simple and enhanced (in terms of performance and a bit of QOL) way to play Minecraft.

**If you want best performance and normal Minecraft, you dont need to search anymore**
